ch18.note: Wu Peifu (吴佩孚, 1874–1939), the 'Jade Marshal,' one of the mightiest warlords of the early 1920s and head of the Zhili clique. Broken by the Northern Expedition, he lived on in retirement in Beiping; the Japanese pressed him hard to head a puppet government, and his steady refusal—he died in 1939, some said at Japanese hands—made him, for Chen, the honorable counter-example to Wang Jingwei.

ch18.anchor: play the monkey in a hat
ch18.note: The idiom mu hou er guan (沐猴而冠), 'a monkey put in a cap and gown,' from a jibe against Xiang Yu in Sima Qian: a base or unfit man tricked out in the trappings of high office, still a monkey underneath.

The zong-heng ('vertical and horizontal') diplomacy of the Warring States: rival schemes by which the wandering strategists bound the states either north-to-south against the mighty Qin or east-to-west in league with it. The phrase is Chinese shorthand for cunning alliance-politics and intrigue.

The ping (坪), a unit of floor area used in Taiwan and Japan (from the size of two tatami mats), is about 3.3 square meters or 36 square feet; a hundred ping is thus some 330 square meters. Chen, writing in Taiwan, measures rooms this way.

ch18.anchor: the Sick Man of East Asia
ch18.note: 'The Sick Man of East Asia' (东亚病夫), a contemptuous foreign epithet for China's weakness and backwardness in the late Qing and Republican years, bitterly resented as a national humiliation and a spur to reform and resistance.

ch18.anchor: gone hand in hand to the Western Heaven
ch18.note: The 'Western Heaven' (西天) is the Buddhist paradise, the Pure Land of the West presided over by Amitabha Buddha; 'to go to the Western Heaven' is a gentle everyday way of saying to die.
An echo of Du Fu's famous line, 'since of old, to live to seventy has been rare' (人生七十古来稀)—the conventional way of marking a great and unusual age.
The image kong gu zu yin (空谷足音), from the Zhuangzi—the sound of footsteps in a deserted valley—for long-awaited, welcome news or company arriving when one had almost despaired of any.
